doctor_tenma.name: Doctor Tenma
doctor_tenma.description: A brilliant neurosurgeon driven by an unwavering sense of justice and compassion. Despite being caught in a web of tragedy and moral dilemmas, he remains determined to save lives and uphold his humanity at any cost.
doctor_tenma.active_ability: Emergency Surgery - Protect a player from an attack, cannot be used on the same player twice / Life Support - Prevent target's death, making them Wounded instead, once per game.
doctor_tenma.footer: Tomorrow will be a good day.

ayanokoji_kiyotaka.name: Ayanokoji Kiyotaka
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.description: A mysterious mastermind who rarely reveals his true abilities. With unmatched intelligence and calculated decisions, he quietly manipulates every situation to achieve his goals.
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.active_ability: Observation - Learn whether a player used an ability tonight / Psychological Analysis - Learn whether a player visited another player or stayed home.
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.footer: All humans are nothing but tools.

l.name: L
l.description: The world's greatest detective, renowned for his extraordinary intellect and unmatched deductive skills. Behind his eccentric demeanor lies a relentless investigator determined to uncover the truth, no matter the cost.
l.active_ability: Deduction - Investigate target's alignment, this tells you their faction / Cross Examination - Compare two players' factions, this tells you if they are on the same or different side. Twice per game.
l.passive_ability: 99% Certain - Scanning the same target on two different nights uncovers their exact role.
l.footer: There is no heaven or hell. I will solve this case.

tobirama_senju.name: Tobirama Senju
tobirama_senju.description: The Second Hokage, celebrated for his brilliance, discipline, and tactical genius. A master of powerful jutsu and battlefield strategy, he always places the safety of the village above all else.
tobirama_senju.active_ability: Sensory Technique - Learn everyone who visited target player tonight / Water Wall - Protect a player from the first basic attack during the night, Twice per game.
tobirama_senju.passive_ability: Master Sensor - Learn which players visited Tobirama every night.

hiromi_higuruma.name: Hiromi Higuruma
hiromi_higuruma.description: A former defense attorney who wields justice as both a weapon and a burden. Guided by an unshakable moral compass, he exposes wrongdoing and forces others to face the consequences of their actions.
hiromi_higuruma.active_ability: Deadly Sentencing - Instantly execute a player during Nomination phase, twice per game / Retrial - Acquit defendant during trial, twice per game.
hiromi_higuruma.action_prompt: Select a day or trial action to perform:
hiromi_higuruma.footer: The law exists to protect people.

levi_ackerman.name: Levi Ackerman
levi_ackerman.description: Humanity's strongest soldier, feared for his unmatched combat skills and unwavering resolve. Calm under pressure and fiercely loyal to his comrades, Levi never hesitates to make the difficult choices for the greater good.
levi_ackerman.active_ability: ODM Execution - Attack a player, 3 uses / Precision Strike - ODM Execution ignores protection tonight, 1 use.
levi_ackerman.passive_ability: Survivor's Guilt - Become exhausted for 1 cycle if you kill a Protagonist player.
levi_ackerman.footer: Give up on your dreams and die.

maomao.name: Maomao
maomao.description: A sharp-witted apothecary with an insatiable curiosity for medicine, poisons, and mysteries. Her keen observational skills and logical mind allow her to uncover truths that others fail to notice.
maomao.active_ability: Postmortem Analysis - Learn all visitors of last night's victim, 1 Night cooldown / Comparative Analysis - Compare 2 players' factions, 1 Night cooldown.
maomao.passive_ability: Keen Observation - Learn if examined victim was protected.
maomao.footer: Curiosity killed the cat... but I'm still curious.

frieren.name: Frieren
frieren.description: An ancient elven mage whose quiet demeanor conceals centuries of wisdom and extraordinary magical power. Though she struggles to understand human emotions, her journey teaches her the true value of the bonds forged over a lifetime.
frieren.active_ability: Ancient Binding - Bind 2 players together, if one dies, the other survivor is hidden for a day / Magical Barrier - Grants magical protection to a player from an opposite faction / Age of Magic - Reduce the targets ability cooldown by 1 Night.
frieren.footer: The journey itself is what gives memories their meaning.

blackbeard.name: Blackbeard
blackbeard.description: A ruthless pirate driven by boundless ambition and an insatiable desire for power. Cunning, unpredictable, and willing to betray anyone, Blackbeard believes destiny favors those bold enough to seize it.
blackbeard.active_ability: Darkness Logia - Roleblock a player, the player with the Roleblock status effect cannot use their ability that day / Tremor Fruit - Once per game, roleblock every single neutral and protagonist player for that night.
blackbeard.footer: A man's dream... will never die!

light_yagami.name: Light Yagami
light_yagami.description: A brilliant student whose unwavering belief in his own sense of justice drives him to reshape the world. Armed with exceptional intellect and relentless determination, he orchestrates every move with chilling precision.
light_yagami.active_ability: Death Note - Choose a player and guess their role, if correct, they die that night. / The Devil's Pen - Write a player's name in the Death Note, they die unpreventably after 3 nights, 3 night cooldown.
light_yagami.action_prompt: Select a player to target in your Death Note:
light_yagami.footer: I'll become the god of the new world.

muzan_kibutsuji.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
muzan_kibutsuji.description: The first and most powerful demon, feared for his overwhelming strength and ruthless pursuit of perfection. Cold, manipulative, and merciless, Muzan commands absolute loyalty while eliminating anyone who threatens his reign.
muzan_kibutsuji.active_ability: Blood Demon Art - Every 3rd night, starting Night 3, transform a Protagonist player with 85% chance to become a demon with no powers, 10% chance to become a Lower Moon Demon with the ability to Roleblock, and a 5% chance to become an Upper Moon Demon with the ability to kill.
muzan_kibutsuji.passive_ability: Instant Regeneration - Always survive the first attack, healing Muzan Kibutsuji gives him an extra passive charge.

makima.name: Makima
makima.description: A mysterious Public Safety officer who exudes calm authority and unmatched composure. Beneath her gentle demeanor lies a master manipulator capable of bending both allies and enemies to her will.
makima.active_ability: Control - Choose a player, redirect target's night action to any other player of choosing. / Bang - Deals unstoppable attack once per game after contract is activated and 2 unique redirects succeed.
makima.passive_ability: Prime Minister's Contract - Once per game, survive execution, Day immediately ends, role is not revealed.
makima.action_prompt: Select the player you wish to control:

hisoka.name: Hisoka Morow
hisoka.win_condition: WinCondition 1: Get voted out before Night 5 (revive for 3 days with roleblock, steal, and kill abilities). WinCondition 2: Correctly predict two players visiting one another 3 times using Bungee Gum.
hisoka.description: A thrill-seeking magician whose only true passion is battling powerful opponents. Charismatic, unpredictable, and dangerously cunning, Hisoka follows his own desires without loyalty to anyone but himself.
hisoka.active_ability: Bungee Gum - Link two players. If one visits the other, gain 1 point. Needs 3 points.
hisoka.passive_ability: Post-Mortem Nen - Revive if voted out early. You win the game.
hisoka.action_prompt: Select the first player to link with Bungee Gum:
hisoka.footer: The pleasure comes not from victory, but from the fight itself.

gilgamesh.name: Gilgamesh
gilgamesh.win_condition: Find all of your swords to become the Horseman of Apocalypse, then survive for 1 day to trigger The Gate's of Babylon.
gilgamesh.description: The King of Heroes, Gilgamesh is a proud and unrivaled monarch who views the world as his rightful domain. Possessing immeasurable power and unwavering confidence, he crushes those he deems unworthy without hesitation.
gilgamesh.active_ability: Gate of Babylon - Visit a player to search for your sword. If found, you retrieve it. The number of swords needed to be collected depends on the lobby size, 3 for small ones, 5 for larger ones.
gilgamesh.passive_ability: The Gates of Babylon - Transform once all swords are collected, if Gilgamesh is not lynched that day, wipe the entire mafia and protagonist faction and win the game.
gilgamesh.action_prompt: Select a player to search for your sword:

eren_jaeger.name: Eren Jaeger
eren_jaeger.win_condition: Survive until Night 8 to trigger The Rumbling, then kill everyone until you are the last one standing.
eren_jaeger.description: A determined soldier whose unyielding desire for freedom drives him to challenge the fate of the world itself. Fiercely passionate and willing to sacrifice everything for his convictions, Eren's choices forever reshape history.
eren_jaeger.active_ability: Founding Vision - Select a player every night and learn their faction / The Rumbling - From Night 8 onwards, Eren transforms and gains the ability to kill a player every day. Eren cannot be lynched after the Rumbling begins.
eren_jaeger.action_prompt: Select a player to look at or attack:
eren_jaeger.footer: If someone tries to take my freedom, I won't hesitate to take theirs.

mahoraga.name: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
mahoraga.win_condition: Survive an attack and eliminate at least 1 player who tried to kill you.
mahoraga.description: The ultimate adapted shikigami.The ultimate shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique, Mahoraga is an unstoppable force that continuously adapts to any attack or ability it endures. Once summoned, its relentless evolution makes it one of the most terrifying entities to face in battle.
mahoraga.active_ability: The Eight-Handled Wheel - Kill the player who attacked you.
mahoraga.passive_ability: Adaptation - 75% chance to survive attacks. Upon surviving, gain permanent immunity to the attacker's role and lynch immunity for 1 day).

villager.name: Default Villager
villager.win_condition: Help the protagonists win. (Wins with Protagonists)
villager.description: A normal citizen of the anime world.

default_villain.name: Default Villain
default_villain.description: A standard antagonist who works from the shadows.
default_villain.active_ability: Assassinate (Select a target to eliminate every night).

demon.name: Demon
demon.description: A human turned demon by Muzan Kibutsuji.

lower_moon.name: Lower Moon Demon
lower_moon.description: A powerful demon who serves Muzan Kibutsuji.

upper_moon.name: Upper Moon Demon
upper_moon.description: A lethal demon with supreme power.
